title: Onboard aurora-sky-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Elena Park
description: Add Aurora-Sky 13B v1.0 to the model registry including canonical metadata, quantization and runtime recommendations, performance profiles for common sequence lengths and batch sizes, and automation to emit a changelog entry on merge. Motivation: Aurora-Sky is a widely requested open model with favorable generation quality for multi-turn assistant workloads; adding it to the registry enables Redwood runtime optimizations and standardized perf profiles for Dedicated and Private deployments. This PR adds model metadata (tokenizer/version/architectural notes), performance profiles tuned from bench runs on T4/GPU and A100 hardware, unit/regression tests for profile correctness, updates to the registry changelog generator to pick up new metadata files, and documentation for customers on recommended config. The description below lists commits, changed files, CI results, and review thread summary.

files_changed: models/aurora-sky-13b/v1.0/metadata.json (model metadata, architecture, tokenizer, supported sequences), models/aurora-sky-13b/v1.0/perf_profiles.yaml (per-hardware perf profiles and recommended batch settings), tests/model-registry/test_aurora_profiles.py (profile validation and regression checks), scripts/registry/update_changelog.py (automation to convert model metadata to release notes), ci/model-registry-tests.yml (new CI job to validate registry entries), docs/models/aurora-sky-13b.md (customer-facing guide), .prettierignore (minor formatting update)

release_notes: - Onboard aurora-sky-13b v1.0: model metadata and recommended runtime configs. - Added performance profiles tuned for T4 and A100 with recommended batch sizes and quantization notes. - Changelog automation now picks up new model metadata and emits a draft release note. See docs/models/aurora-sky-13b.md for usage and config examples.
